decisions.reason: This low-pile decorative carpet is a low-cost catalogue addition with no evidence yet of falling short of aspirations, so the firm has little cause to start a search for other uses of its resources after one year.
The hand-knotted wool-silk carpet is a premium item that builds the brand, and existing slack lets the firm carry its uncertain early sales.
This second low-pile decorative carpet overlaps with A and could be pruned in an assortment review, but without a clear shortfall it is likely to stay on the market.
The corner bench fits the firm's core furniture business and has development costs already sunk, so it will probably be kept unless results clearly miss the aspiration level.
This low-pile carpet costs little to list, and one year of uncertain results does not trigger a search for alternatives.
The swivel shell chair is a core seating product with steady demand, so dropping it within a year is unlikely.
